card.name: Dateline dates and state abbreviations
card.fires_on: The last digit of a year, or a month or state abbreviation, in a news dateline or date stamp at the start of a web article.

modes.label: Final year digit
modes.description: The last digit or two of a year in a dated article header.
modes.example: May 10, 201<<2>> Forests in the Amazon Basin are expected

modes.label: Month in day-month-year
modes.description: An abbreviated or full month inside a date like 19 May 2011.

modes.label: State abbreviation
modes.description: A two-letter US state code after a city in a dateline or location.
modes.example: RODALE NEWS, EMMAUS,<< PA>>—Eating local can be tricky.

card.plain: It marks the end of a date or place stamp at the top of a news item, just before the story starts.
